query: SELECT marriage, image_genre, death_date FROM Art WHERE century != '19th' OR name != 'Ben Shahn' OR art_institution = 'Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts' OR teaching > 0;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: century <> '19th' OR name <> 'Ben Shahn' OR art_institution = 'Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts' OR teaching > 0
逻辑补出的原文抽取；art_institution, century, death_date, image_genre, marriage, name, teaching
